I've updated the records and replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

- **Records:** I saved a new note that the deadline for Tansley Parcel's signed order form is 3 April. The note says this corrects the date she posted in #central-team this morning. I also withdrew the earlier record of 25 August. No year was given, so the record doesn't have one.
- **Reply to Pree:** I confirmed the change and told her I did nothing else. Her original message in #central-team still says 25 August, so I suggested she fix it there too, in case the team goes by the old date.

A deadline date is an operational fact, not a money term, so no approval was needed and Pree could see everything I used.
